facts.fact: The Government of Lesotho states the Minister of Information, Communications, Science, Technology and Innovation took part virtually in the 21st Smart Africa Alliance Meeting (no meeting date given; the document's published date 2026-10-12 is used).
The Government of Lesotho states Lesotho joined the Smart Africa Alliance in 2025 and has since benefited from initiatives in AI, data and digital skills.
Lesotho hosted the sixth SADC countries cyber drill and Africa-CERT meeting in Maseru, opened by the Principal Secretary of the ICT ministry, with the SADC Secretariat represented.
The Principal Secretary told SADC delegates that Lesotho is now part of the Smart Africa Alliance.

facts.fact: The Government of Lesotho (via LENA) states Lesotho, the newest member of Smart Africa, was selected as a participant in creating a national data blueprint, and hosted the first national stakeholder workshop in Maseru with Smart Africa and the African Union.
Smart Africa said on 2026-03-24 that it welcomed this country as one of six recently joined member states, taking the Alliance to 42.
